summary: Iter12 — Saved Searches (email+Telegram) + new Tatiana quiz steps (repair, buyer_type) fully verified. Backend: 12/12 pytest GREEN after fixing one timezone-comparison bug in telegram_webhook. Frontend: chat now defaults to quiz mode, 6-step flow with repair+buyer step completes and returns matches; SaveSearch modal+MySearches page work for logged-in users; logged-out users get the need-login screen.

minor.issue: FIXED — was returning 500 due to naive-vs-aware datetime comparison (Mongo returns naive, _now() is utc-aware). Patched /app/backend/routes/auto/saved_search.py to normalise expires_at to UTC before comparing.

ui_bugs.issue: Cards do not carry the expected data-testid prefix 'my-search-card-' — querySelectorAll returned 0 even though cards render (verified visually). Other testids (my-searches-need-login, my-searches-tg-bind) work as specified.

action_items: (optional) Add `data-testid="my-search-card-{id}"` to each subscription card root in MySearches.jsx so e2e tests can iterate them deterministically.

Code-review nit: services/auto_saved_search_service.py — _filters_to_mongo treats `damage_only=False` the same as None (the `if f.damage_only:` branch is skipped); if you want to allow explicit «only undamaged» you need a tri-state.

Code-review nit: auto_saved_search_service.run_all stores `last_match_ids` as the last 100 ids, but the dedupe window is also gated by `created_at > last_run_at`, which means the explicit dedupe is largely redundant unless vehicles are re-imported with stale created_at.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/auto/saved_search.py:199 had a naive/aware datetime crash on the Telegram /start path — fixed in-place; PLEASE keep the fix and add a regression test.

models/auto_saved_search.py keeps both `price_from_nzd` AND `price_from_rub` as independent optional fields — the conversion is silent in _filters_to_mongo. If a caller sets both, NZD wins without warning; consider normalising at the Pydantic layer.

saved_search.py duplicates `from services.auto_saved_search_service import AutoSavedSearchService` inside every handler. Move to module-level to avoid the per-request import cost and to surface circular-import problems early.

auto_notify_service.send_email swallows every Resend failure as `status:error` — fine for the runner, but the modal flow could surface a friendlier 'mail not sent' to the user when their email is not europrestige@gmail.com.
seed_data_creation: Three temporary leads created by /quiz/submit (TEST_iter12_quiz / TEST_iter12_quiz_nofilter / TEST_iter12_ui) and visible in admin Клиенты as kind=lead. One TEST_iter12_subscription saved-search was created via the UI and deleted at the end of the run. Telegram tokens for chat_id=99 were inserted and the binding was reset via /telegram/unbind.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified endpoints (all 200 unless noted): GET /api/auto/quiz/meta now exposes 'repairs' (no/light/any) and 'buyer_types' (private/dealer/company). POST /api/auto/quiz/submit accepts repair + buyer_type and filters damage_type accordingly. POST /api/auto/saved-searches/preview is public and returns {matches:[], fx_rate:Number}. POST /api/auto/saved-searches (auth) creates a row; GET /api/auto/saved-searches lists them; PATCH /toggle flips enabled; DELETE removes. POST /api/auto/telegram/start-binding returns deep_link + token + bot_username='AvtoresursAlertsBot'. GET /api/auto/telegram/binding-status reports {bound, chat_id}. POST /api/auto/telegram/webhook with /start link_<token> now binds correctly (after the naive-vs-aware datetime fix). POST /api/auto/admin/saved-searches/run returns {searches,notified,matches,errors} as ints. Frontend testids confirmed: chat-fab, quiz-flow, chat-switch-to-free, quiz-step-0..5, quiz-purpose-*, quiz-body-*, quiz-budget-*, quiz-country-*, quiz-urgency-*, quiz-repair-*, quiz-buyer-*, quiz-name-input, quiz-contact-input, quiz-next-btn, quiz-submit-btn, quiz-result, save-search-btn, save-search-modal, save-search-name, save-search-email, save-search-telegram, save-search-submit, save-search-done, my-searches-need-login, my-searches-tg-bind. Step ordering in QuizFlow: 0=purpose, 1=body, 2=budget, 3=country+urgency, 4=repair+buyer, 5=name+contact (= '6 шагов' counter).
rca of the issue: Bug: POST /api/auto/telegram/webhook returned 500 for valid /start link_<token> payloads. Root cause: saved_search.py:199 compared `doc['expires_at']` (read back from Mongo as a naive datetime) against `_now()` (timezone.utc-aware), which raises TypeError. Reproduction: POST /api/auto/telegram/webhook {message:{chat:{id:99},text:'/start link_<token>'}}. Mitigation applied: normalise `expires_at` to UTC before comparing (re-attach tzinfo if naive).
